fighter.name: The Fighter
fighter.title: The Next Blacksmith
fighter.text: Everyone expected you to take over the forge. Your hands know iron. When The Fort needed another sword on the wall, you picked one up instead.
fighter.oseLine: Fighter 1 · AC 4 [15] · HD 1d8 (8 hp) · THAC0 19 [+0] · SV D12 W13 P14 B15 S16 · sword 1d8, STR +1 · 3 Fate
fighter.note5e: 5e: Fighter 1 · AC 15 · hp 8 · sword (1d8+1) · force doors 3-in-6.

paladin.name: The Paladin
paladin.title: Warden of the Gate
paladin.text: There was an order, once. It is gone. The oath is not. You are Maren's heir, and you carry it the way a house carries a foundation.
paladin.oseLine: Half-Elf Paladin 1 · AC 4 [15] · HD 1d8 (8 hp) · THAC0 19 [+0] · SV D10 W11 P12 B13 S14 · longsword 1d8, STR +1, lay on hands 2 HP, infravision 30' · 3 Fate
paladin.note5e: 5e: Paladin 1 · AC 15 · hp 8 · longsword (1d8+1) · lay on hands 2 hp once a day.

elf.name: The Elf
elf.title: The One Who Stayed
elf.text: There is one elf at The Fort. You. The others left, or you left them. You see in the dark. You brought no torches. The humans did.
elf.oseLine: Elf 1 · AC 5 [14] · HD 1d6 (6 hp) · THAC0 19 [+0] · SV D12 W13 P13 B15 S15 · longsword 1d8, Light (12 turns), infravision 60', secret doors 2-in-6 · 3 Fate
elf.note5e: 5e: Elf (fighter/mage) 1 · AC 14 · hp 6 · longsword (1d8) · cantrip light for 12 turns.

minister.name: The Minister
minister.title: The Last Keeper
minister.text: She tends the Terminal at the centre of The Fort, a screen set in stone that still scrolls hymns nobody fully understands. She goes with the party because someone has to.
minister.oseLine: Cleric 1 · AC 7 [12] · HD 1d6 (6 hp) · THAC0 19 [+0] · SV D11 W12 P14 B16 S15 · staff 1d4, cure light wounds, turn undead 7+ skeletons, 9+ zombies · 3 Fate
minister.note5e: 5e: Cleric 1 · AC 12 · hp 6 · staff (1d4) · cure wounds once a day · turns undead.

wizard.name: The Wizard
wizard.title: The Runaway Apprentice
wizard.text: You left your master, your tower, your books. Magic is rare on the frontier. People need you. That is new.
wizard.oseLine: Magic-User 1 · AC 9 [10] · HD 1d4 (4 hp) · THAC0 19 [+0] · SV D13 W14 P13 B16 S15 · dagger 1d4, STR -1, Sleep · 3 Fate
wizard.note5e: 5e: Wizard 1 · AC 10 · hp 4 · dagger (1d4-1) · sleep once a day.

elf-minister.name: The Elf Minister
elf-minister.title: The One Who Believes
elf-minister.text: You are the thing that shouldn't exist: an elf who chose the Terminal. It took eleven years for the words on the screen to change. You are very, very patient.
elf-minister.oseLine: Elf Cleric 1 · AC 7 [12] · HD 1d6 (6 hp) · THAC0 19 [+0] · SV D10 W11 P14 B16 S14 · mace 1d6, STR -1, cure light wounds, turn undead, infravision 60' · 3 Fate
elf-minister.note5e: 5e: Cleric 1 (elf) · AC 12 · hp 6 · mace (1d6-1) · cure wounds once a day · turns undead.

gnome-druid.name: The Gnome Druid
gnome-druid.title: The One Who Listens
gnome-druid.text: Nobody heard you coming. You walked out of the deep forest barefoot, carrying a staff taller than you. You talk to things that don't have mouths.
gnome-druid.oseLine: Gnome Druid 1 · AC 7 [12] · HD 1d6 (6 hp) · THAC0 19 [+0] · SV D10 W11 P12 B15 S14 · staff 1d6, STR -1, speak with animals, infravision 60' · 3 Fate
gnome-druid.note5e: 5e: Druid 1 (gnome) · AC 12 · hp 6 · staff (1d6-1) · speak with animals once a day.
